entries.doc: Linear warmup followed by constant schedule i.e no decay.

entries.name: warmup_cosine_decay_schedule
entries.doc: Linear warmup followed by cosine decay.

entries.name: warmup_exponential_decay_schedule
entries.doc: Linear warmup followed by exponential decay.

entries.name: fisher_diag
entries.doc: Computes the diagonal of the (observed) Fisher information matrix.

entries.name: hessian_diag
entries.doc: Computes the diagonal hessian of `loss` at (`inputs`, `targets`).

entries.name: hvp
entries.doc: Performs an efficient vector-Hessian (of `loss`) product.

entries.name: NamedTupleKey
entries.doc: KeyType for a NamedTuple in a tree.

entries.name: tree_add
entries.doc: Add two (or more) pytrees.

entries.name: tree_add_scale
entries.doc: Add two trees, where the second tree is scaled by a scalar.

entries.name: tree_allclose
entries.doc: Check whether two trees are element-wise approximately equal within a tolerance.

entries.name: tree_batch_shape
entries.doc: Add leading batch dimensions to each leaf of a pytree.

entries.name: tree_bias_correction
entries.doc: Performs bias correction. It becomes a no-op as count goes to infinity.

entries.name: tree_cast
entries.doc: Cast tree to given dtype, skip if None.

entries.name: tree_cast_like
entries.doc: Cast tree to dtypes of other_tree.

entries.name: tree_clip
entries.doc: Creates an identical tree where all tensors are clipped to `[min, max]`.

entries.name: tree_conj
entries.doc: Compute the conjugate of a pytree.

entries.name: tree_div
entries.doc: Divide two pytrees.

entries.name: tree_dtype
entries.doc: Fetch dtype of tree.

entries.name: tree_full_like
entries.doc: Creates an identical tree where all tensors are filled with ``fill_value``.

entries.name: tree_get
entries.doc: Extract a value from a pytree matching a given key.

entries.name: tree_get_all_with_path
entries.doc: Extract values of a pytree matching a given key.

entries.name: tree_map_params
entries.doc: Apply a callable over all params in the given optimizer state.

entries.name: tree_max
entries.doc: Compute the max of all the elements in a pytree.

entries.name: tree_min
entries.doc: Compute the min of all the elements in a pytree.

entries.name: tree_mul
entries.doc: Multiply two pytrees.

entries.name: tree_norm
entries.doc: Compute the vector norm of the given ord of a pytree.

entries.name: tree_ones_like
entries.doc: Creates an all-ones tree with the same structure.

entries.name: tree_random_like
entries.doc: Create tree with random entries of the same shape as target tree.

entries.name: tree_real
entries.doc: Compute the real part of a pytree.

entries.name: tree_scale
entries.doc: Multiply a tree by a scalar.

entries.name: tree_set
entries.doc: Creates a copy of tree with some values replaced as specified by kwargs.

entries.name: tree_size
entries.doc: Total size of a pytree.

entries.name: tree_split_key_like
entries.doc: Split keys to match structure of target tree.

entries.name: tree_sub
entries.doc: Subtract two pytrees.

entries.name: tree_sum
entries.doc: Compute the sum of all the elements in a pytree.

entries.name: tree_unwrap_random_key_data
entries.doc: Unwrap random.key objects in a tree for numerical comparison.

entries.name: tree_update_infinity_moment
entries.doc: Compute the exponential moving average of the infinity norm.

entries.name: tree_update_moment
entries.doc: Compute the exponential moving average of the `order`-th moment.

entries.name: tree_update_moment_per_elem_norm
entries.doc: Compute the EMA of the `order`-th moment of the element-wise norm.

entries.name: tree_vdot
entries.doc: Compute the inner product between two pytrees.

entries.name: tree_where
entries.doc: Select tree_x values if condition is true else tree_y values.

entries.name: tree_zeros_like
entries.doc: Creates an all-zeros tree with the same structure.
